text:
Alex: FYI console quota graphs show a drop for some routes after the compact route header rollout this morning. Looks like telemetry lost the route tag for a subset of requests.
Maya: Which header change specifically? the compact-routeheader deploy? @Ravi
Ravi: Yes, we switched from route-affinity to x-rd-route-priority at 09:12. Most infra comp handles it, but console ingestion still keys on route-affinity.
Jules: Runtime was temporarily emitting both headers, but the batching proxy strips unknown headers. That means downstream metrics-ingest sees nothing and falls back to default route bucket.
Alex: Quick repro: curl with old header -> shows per-route metric; with x-rd-route-priority -> goes to default. Screenshot uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ops/clip123
Maya: Proposal: add an ingest-time mapping (x-rd-route-priority -> route-affinity) behind a feature flag for 48h. Also log when mapping triggers. Low-risk and quick.
Ravi: Sounds good. Also plan to add a short-lived SDK compat env var so canary customers can have SDK send legacy header while we ramp. That avoids gaps.
Nora: Dashboard/alerts concern: if we remap in ingestion, do alerting thresholds and per-tenant aliases remain correct? Need to ensure we preserve tenant route keys exactly.
Jules: Implementation note: metrics-ingest runs in k8s as service metrics-ingest. We can add a header remap in the parser stage. Aggregators use sampling keys; we must ensure mapped tag is included in aggregation keys.
Alex: Pseudo patch idea:
```
hdr = headers.get("x-rd-route-priority") or headers.get("route-affinity")
if hdr:
  tags["route_affinity"] = normalize(hdr)
```
Maya: Timeline: PR to infra in 2h, feature-flag to 10% tenants on staging, validate dashboards for ~2h, then ramp.
Ravi: Also add a telemetry event from SDKs when the compat env var is enabled so we can count how many clients rely on fallback: "event: route_header_compat, sdk: py/ts/go, mode: legacy_fallback".
CI-bot: deploy to staging started by @Maya  build 1382  logs: https://ci.redwood/build/1382
Jules: Watch out for duplicates: aggregator dedupe window is 60s. If both headers are present mapping could create duplicate metrics. Rule: prefer the new header if both present to avoid double-counting.
Nora: Support note: "If you notice a sudden drop in Route X usage, toggle the SDK compat env var or enable ingestion mapping temporarily." We'll add to KB.
Maya: Opening infra PR and support KB now.
Alex: Thanks. I'll keep monitoring metrics and follow up in #incidents if it spikes. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: staging deploy complete  1769001400
Maya: Staging validated, no regressions. Rolling FF to prod at 10% now.
Ravi: Prod FF deployed  1769001600  monitoring metric parity.
